spans.s:
Miracle,Ⓒs.ⒹadButaM, alOkikakriyA-karman n. adButaM-lokottaraM-karma, AScaryaM; camatkAraH, atimAnuzaM karma, devaM karma.
ⓃMiraculous,Ⓒa.ⒹadButa, lokottara, AScaryaBUta, AScarya, amAnuza (zI f.), atimartya, divya, apOruzeya (yI f.).
Ⓑ
 2 adButaSaktisaMpanna; ‘m(iraculous) weapon’ divyAstraM.
Ⓝ[Miraculous]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹadButatayA, divyaSaktyA.

Mire,Ⓒs.ⒹpaMkaH, kardamaH, jaMbAlaH-laM, malaH-laM; ‘get into the m(ire)’ saMkawe nikzip pass. or pat 1 P.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹpaMkena duz c. (dUzayati) or lip 6 P.
Ⓝ[Mir]y,Ⓒa.ⒹpaMkila, sakadarma, sapaMka, samala, kaluza, paMkaklinna, paMkadUzita.

Mirror,Ⓒs.ⒹdarpaRaH, AdarSaH, mukuraH, AtmadarSaH.
Ⓑ
 2 (Fig.) AdarSaH, pratimA.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹReflect, q. v.

Mirth,Ⓒs.ⒹhAsyaM, pra-, modaH, ullAsaH, AnaMdaH, kOtukaM, parihAsaH; See Merriment.
Ⓝ[Mirth]ful,Ⓒa.Ⓓhfzwa, ullasita, AnaMdita, pramudita; See Merry.
